$comment: OURS. The response format a delegated worker returns, read by `magus ledger accept`. Mirrors ledger.Report; TestReportSchemaMatchesTheStruct fails when either side grows a field the other lacks.
title: magus lease worker report

lease.description: The lease id this report answers. Checked against the ledger row when present.

changed_paths.description: Workspace-relative paths this worker wrote. Every one must fall inside the lease's owned paths.

descendants.description: Lease ids this worker handed work on to. Empty unless it spawned any.

unresolved_risks.description: What this worker could not settle. Required even when empty: an absent list and a considered-and-empty one must not look alike.

command.description: The one check the lease was assigned, as it was run.

output_ref.description: The reference id magus stored that run's captured output under, so the root can reopen the bytes.

passed.description: The worker's verdict on its own run.
